# The Stoop LLC

> The Stoop is a Pittsburgh-based digital advertising and influencer marketing agency founded in 2019 by Michael Pernice. We help brands scale through authentic influencer partnerships, paid media, organic social management, content production, and marketing automation, and we run a 1-on-1 influencer coaching program for creators building sustainable careers. Contact: mike@thestooppgh.com, +1 (412) 616-0542.

Key facts: based in Pittsburgh, PA; serves local and national clients; specialties include fitness, food & beverage, healthcare and patient advocacy, nonprofits, landscaping, and sports performance. Documented results include 480,334 views for the Dr. Tea #LoveIsBrewing campaign, a $47,139 nonprofit capital campaign for MFPAA (446 donors, 87% lower CPC than benchmarks), and 267,838 views across two X Shadyside influencer campaign seasons.

## Services

- [Influencer Marketing](https://thestooppgh.com/services/influencer-marketing.html): End-to-end influencer campaigns — strategy, sourcing, vetting, execution, and ROI reporting
- [Digital Advertising](https://thestooppgh.com/services/digital-advertising.html): Paid social and programmatic campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google
- [Organic Social](https://thestooppgh.com/services/organic-social.html): Community-first social media management and growth strategy
- [Content Development](https://thestooppgh.com/services/content-development.html): Short-form video, UGC, photography, and branded content production
- [Automation & Ops](https://thestooppgh.com/services/automation-ops.html): Marketing automation, CRM workflows, and operational systems
- [Design & Branding](https://thestooppgh.com/services/design-branding.html): Logo and brand identity systems, guidelines, stationery, campaign creative, and brand films
- [Website Design](https://thestooppgh.com/services/website-design.html): Custom, SEO-optimized websites built to convert
- [Influencer Coaching](https://thestooppgh.com/services/influencer-coaching.html): 1-on-1 coaching for creators — pitching, negotiation, media kits, and monetization
- [Pricing](https://thestooppgh.com/pricing.html): Transparent pricing for all services
- [Contact](https://thestooppgh.com/contact): One inquiry form for every service; choose a service and we reply within 24 hours

## Case Studies

- [All Case Studies](https://thestooppgh.com/work/): Portfolio index of every case study with headline results
- [X Shadyside](https://thestooppgh.com/work/x-shadyside.html): Two influencer-led membership campaign seasons for a Pittsburgh fitness facility — 267K+ views, 15 influencers
- [Dr. Tea](https://thestooppgh.com/work/dr-tea.html): #LoveIsBrewing brand launch and influencer campaign — 480,334 views, 651,244 impressions
- [MFPAA](https://thestooppgh.com/work/mfpaa.html): Nonprofit EMS capital campaign — $47,139 raised from 446 donors in 30 days
- [Iron 24](https://thestooppgh.com/work/iron-24.html): Content production and influencer activation across two markets
- [SXP](https://thestooppgh.com/work/sxp.html): Brand video production and multi-brand partnership for a sports performance clinic
- [Sylvan Gardens](https://thestooppgh.com/work/sylvan-gardens.html): Organic social growth for a landscaping company
- [Case Specific Meal Prep](https://thestooppgh.com/work/csmp.html): Themed content calendar and production for a food brand
- [Take a Nurse](https://thestooppgh.com/work/take-a-nurse.html): Brand identity system for a Pittsburgh patient-advocacy business — logo lockups in five color variants, palette, type system, business cards, letterhead, and a nine-page brand guide (August–September 2026)
- [Union Trust Building](https://thestooppgh.com/work/union-trust-building.html): Instagram and Facebook for a historic downtown Pittsburgh office landmark — event coverage, recurring video series, tenant newsletter; +22% IG followers and 2.6x IG reach in six months
